resolved: “Switch is_counter_offer_percent_bid_allowed from On to Off during the same Responses-screen session and compare the visi” — require_setting switches that company setting before the case and back after

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ Responses screen with one vendor bid, as required for this case.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the scenario.
Keep the RFQ counter-offer control available for the visibility check.
Apply the required buyer bid-rejection configuration.
Apply the required buyer bid-edit configuration.
Set the configuration under test to Off before inspecting the prepared live RFQ.
Assert that the RFQ counter-offer control remains visible with the setting Off.
Explore the available counter-offer control without confirming or sending a counter offer.
Assert that inspecting the control did not produce a rendering error or unexpected screen failure.
